or [green]【Tono Hanna】{IfUpgraded:show:+|}[/green] to add to your hand
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SHERRYLIN_TWELVE.title: Fujido Arisa
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SHERRYLIN_TWELVE.descr: Reduce an ally's [b]【Suspect】[/b] by {ConsumeAmount:diff()} stack(s), gain {IfUpgraded:show:{energyPrefix:energyIcons(3)}|{energyPrefix:energyIcons(2)}}, apply {SuspectPower:diff()} stack(s) of [b]【Suspect】[/b] to yourself, gain 1 stack of [color=#ff0000]【Fujido Arisa's Magic】[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_A_STUDY_IN_SCARLET.des: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If you [b]Exhausted[/b] a card this [color=33ccff]turn[/color], draw 1
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_THE_VALLEY_OF_FEAR.des: [b]Exhaust[/b] all cards in hand, draw that many cards. For each card drawn, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_THE_THREE_GARRIDEBS.de: Gain 5 Block. If you triggered Case Reversal this [color=33ccff]turn[/color], gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(3)}{IfUpgraded:show:, draw 1 card|}
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_THE_ENGINEERS_THUMB.de:
[b]Exhaust[/b] 1 card in hand, gain [b]Block[/b] equal to its cost times {BlockMultiplier:diff()}.
If the [b]Exhausted[/b] card cost 2 or more, draw 1 card
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_THE_BLUE_CARBUNCLE.des: Randomly [b]Exhaust[/b] 1 card in hand, draw {Cards:diff()} card(s)
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SILVER_BLAZE.title: Silver Blaze
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SILVER_BLAZE.descripti: Randomly [b]Exhaust[/b] 1 [b]Attack[/b] card in hand, generate 1 【Substitute】 with the corresponding base values
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SILVER_BLAZE_TOKEN.des:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If 10 damage is dealt, draw 1
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_THE_SIX_NAPOLEONS.desc: Randomly [b]Exhaust[/b] cards in your deck equal to the number of [color=#33ccff]【Tachibana Sherry's Magic】[/color] stacks. For every {Divisor:diff()} cards [b]Exhausted[/b], generate 1 card of higher rarity
Gain 8 Block, return 1 random card from the [color=#33ccff][b]Exhaust[/b] pile[/color] to your hand. This [color=33ccff]turn[/color], it costs 0
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_THE_SECOND_STAIN.title: The Second Stain
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_THE_SECOND_STAIN.descr: Choose 1 card from the [color=#33ccff]discard pile[/color] to [b]Exhaust[/b] and play it once{IfUpgraded:show: and gain [b]Block[/b] equal to its cost times {BlockMultiplier:diff()}|}
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_THE_DANCING_MEN.title: The Dancing Men
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_THE_DANCING_MEN.descri: [color=33ccff]At the start of turn[/color], choose 1 card from the [color=#33ccff]draw pile[/color] to [b]Exhaust[/b], gain Temporary [b]Strength[/b] equal to its cost, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_THE_LIONS_MANE.title: The Lion's Mane
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_THE_LIONS_MANE.descrip: Gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy. While in the [color=#33ccff][b]Exhaust[/b] pile[/color], [color=33ccff]automatically plays at the start of turn[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_THE_COPPER_BEECHES.des: Gain {Block:diff()} [b]Block[/b]. If you [b]Exhausted[/b] a card this [color=33ccff]turn[/color], gain an additional {Block:diff()} [b]Block[/b]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_THE_DEVILS_FOOT.title: The Devil's Foot
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_THE_DEVILS_FOOT.descri: Deal damage equal to the number of cards in the [color=#33ccff]exhaust pile[/color] times {Multiplier:diff()} to all enemies. Gain equal [b]Block[/b]. Recover all {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} up to your max
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_THE_GRANGE_PUZZLE.desc:
Randomly upgrade {IfUpgraded:show:+2} cards in the [color=#33ccff]exhaust pile[/color] equal to your [color=#33ccff]【Tachibana Sherry's Magic】[/color] stacks.
Return one-third of the [color=#33ccff]【Tachibana Sherry's Magic】[/color] stacks worth of cards from the exhaust pile to your hand
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMOTION_ANGER.title: Anger
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMOTION_ANGER.descript:
[color=#CC6666]【Nikaido Hiro】[/color]
Deal double [color=#CC6666]damage[/color]. For every 20 [color=#CC6666]damage[/color] dealt, deal 1 [color=#CC6666]damage[/color] to a random ally
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMOTION_DISGUST.title: Disgust
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMOTION_DISGUST.descri:
[color=#6666cc]【Natsume An'an】[/color]
When you [color=#6666cc]receive[/color] an enemy's [b]attack[/b], deal equal damage back [color=#6666cc]affected by abilities[/color]. When your HP bar is hit, immediately [color=#6666cc]remove[/color] this
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMOTION_SADNESS.title: Sadness
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMOTION_SADNESS.descri:
[color=#ffcc99]【Hikami Meruru】[/color]
[color=#ffcc99]This turn[/color], every time you play a card, gain 1 [color=#ffcc99]Block[/color] and heal a random ally (including yourself) for 1 [color=#ffcc99]HP[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMOTION_FEAR.title: Fear
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMOTION_FEAR.descripti:
[color=#ff99cc]【Sakuraha Ema】[/color]
You cannot play [color=#ff99cc][b]Attack[/b][/color] cards.
[color=#ff99cc]At the end of turn[/color], gain half of your current [color=#ff99cc][b]Block[/b][/color], and randomly give an equal amount of [b]Block[/b] to a [color=#ff99cc]ally[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMOTION_JOY.title: Joy
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMOTION_JOY.descriptio:
[purple]【Hosho Mag】[/purple]
[purple]This turn[/purple], every time you play an [purple]Attack[/purple] card, gain 1 stack of [purple]Temporary [b]Strength[/b] loss[/purple]. Every time you play 1 [purple][b]Attack[/b][/purple], 1 [purple]Skill[/purple], and 1 [purple]Power[/purple] card, gain 2 Energy
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMOTION_SURPRISE.title: Surprise
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMOTION_SURPRISE.descr:
[color=#cc9966]【Saeki Miria】[/color]
[color=#cc9966]At the end of turn[/color], record your current hand size. At the [color=#cc9966]start of next turn[/color], draw that many cards
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMOTION_MELANCHOLY.des:
[color=#999999]【Kurobe Naeha】[/color]
Every time you play a [color=#999999][b]Attack[/b][/color] card, gain 1 stack of [color=#999999]Temporary [b]Strength[/b] loss[/color], and a random ally heals 2 [color=#999999]HP[/color]. Every time you play a Skill, gain 2 [color=#999999][b]Block[/b][/color]. For every 3 [color=#999999]Skill[/color] cards played, recover 1 Energy. Playing a [color=#999999]Power[/color] card gives all allies 1 Energy
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMOTION_IRRITATED_FEAR:
[color=#ff9966]【Sawatari Koko】[/color]
Cannot play [color=#ff9966][b]Attack[/b][/color] cards.
[color=#ff9966]At the end of turn[/color], lose 3 HP, then [color=#ff9966]you and your allies[/color] gain Block equal to the remaining HP lost this way
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMOTION_DESOLATE.title: Desolate
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMOTION_DESOLATE.descr:
[color=#ff0000]【Fujido Arisa】[/color]
Cannot play [color=#ff0000][b]Attack[/b][/color] cards and [color=#ff0000]Power[/color] cards.
[color=#ff0000]At the end of turn[/color], heal HP equal to half of your [color=#ff0000]Block[/color], and at the start of next turn gain that much Block
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMOTION_HORROR_DISGUST:
[gold]【Hasumi Leah】[/gold]
When you receive [gold]damage[/gold], deal damage equal to the amount taken [gold]affected by abilities[/gold] to all enemies and draw 1. At the start of the [gold]next turn[/gold], deal 1 damage equal to your [gold]hand size[/gold] to random enemies
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMOTION_ELATION.title: Elation
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMOTION_ELATION.descri:
[blue]【Shirosaki Noah】[/blue]
Immediately gain Energy equal to your [blue]max Energy[/blue] and an equal amount of [blue]Next Turn Energy Loss[/blue]. When you draw [blue]4[/blue] cards, [blue]lose 1 stack[/blue] of Next Turn Energy Loss. When you have no Next Turn Energy Loss, [blue]this effect triggers again[/blue]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMOTION_CURIOSITY.desc:
[color=33ccff]【Tachibana Sherry】[/color]
When Case Reversal triggers, gain [color=33ccff]【Tachibana Sherry's Magic】[/color] equal to the number of cards moved from the [color=33ccff]discard pile[/color] to the [b]Exhaust[/b] pile. Draw one quarter of [color=33ccff]【Tachibana Sherry's Magic】[/color] cards, gain one quarter of the Exhaust pile size as Energy
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMOTION_HELPLESSNESS.d:
[green]【Tono Hanna】[/green]
At the start of turn, increase card costs by 1. Cards costing 4 or more gain [green]Float[/green].
At the end of turn, if this is in your hand, randomly increase the counter on 1 [color=33ccff]Witchification[/color] card by 1.
Gain {Strength} Strength, lose {Dexterity} Dexterity, deal {Damage} damage, gain {Block} Block
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMOTION_FRIENDSHIP.des:
[color=#33ccff][b]「Free[/b][/color][green][b]dom」[/b][/green]
[color=#33ccff]Every card played[/color], draw 2. The first time a card is played, its cost increases by 1. The second time it's played, its cost returns to normal (alternating).
[green]Every two cards played[/green], gain 1 Temporary Strength.
[color=#ff99cc]Every three cards played[/color], recover 1 Energy.
[color=#ffcc99]Every 4 cards played[/color], [b]Exhaust[/b] 1 [color=33ccff]Curse[/color]/[green]Status[/green] card in hand
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMOTION_SURGE.title: Emotion Surge
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMOTION_SURGE.descript: [color=33ccff]This turn[/color], every time you play a card, gain an additional +1 to the Emotion counter.
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SHERRYLIN_MENTAL_TRAUM:
Gain 1 stack of [rainbow][b]【Emotion】[/b][/rainbow]
{IfUpgraded:show:Choose 1 card from the [color=#33ccff]draw pile[/color] to [b]Exhaust[/b]|}
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_CYCLE_MIND.title: Cycling Mindset
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_CYCLE_MIND.description: If [b]【Others' Emotions】[/b] has cards, give a random card in the [color=#33ccff]draw pile[/color] Replay {IfUpgraded:show:2|1}
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_MADNESS_SPREAD.title: Madness Spread
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_MADNESS_SPREAD.descrip:
Randomly play cards from the [color=#33ccff]draw pile[/color] totaling an [b]Exhausted[/b] cost of {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}{IfUpgraded:show:+2|}.
Deal 1 damage to a random enemy for each card played
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ABANDON_RESHAPE.title: Forsake Reshape
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ABANDON_RESHAPE.descri: Choose {IfUpgraded:show:2 cards|1 card} in hand to [color=#33ccff]remove[/color] for this combat. Generate 1 colorless [b]Exhaust[/b] card into your hand
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMOTION_MIMIC.title: Emotion Mimicry
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMOTION_MIMIC.descript: Choose 1 basic [rainbow][b]【Emotion】[/b][/rainbow] card from [b]【Others' Emotions】[/b], add a copy to your hand
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_PERPETUAL_FRENZY.title: Perpetual Frenzy
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_PERPETUAL_FRENZY.descr:
Double your current [rainbow][b]【Emotion】[/b][/rainbow] index. If a [rainbow][b]【Emotion】[/b][/rainbow] card is gained from this, 1 random card in hand costs 0 this [color=33ccff]turn[/color]{IfUpgraded:show:|
[color=#33ccff]Remove[/color]}
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_INSTANT_STRIKE.title: Instant Strike
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_THREE_FOLD_TRICK.title: Three-Fold Trick
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_THREE_FOLD_TRICK.descr: Draw {Cards:diff()} cards. [color=33ccff]This turn[/color], your next [b]Attack[/b] card costs 0
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_MAD_CARD_CHASE.title: Mad Card Chase
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_MAD_CARD_CHASE.descrip: Add the top 3 cards of your [color=#33ccff]draw pile[/color] to your hand. [color=33ccff]At the end of turn[/color], randomly play 1/3 of the cards currently in your hand
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ZERO_ENERGY_GRAB.title: Zero Energy Grab
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ZERO_ENERGY_GRAB.descr: Add {Cards:diff()} random zero-cost cards to your hand. These cards are removed when played
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_DUAL_ASCENSION.title: Dual Ascension
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_DUAL_ASCENSION.descrip: For every 5 cards played, randomly upgrade 1 card in hand{IfUpgraded:show: and 1 in the [color=#33ccff]draw pile[/color]|}
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_NASCENT_EMOTION.title: Nascent Emotion
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_NASCENT_EMOTION.descri: [color=33ccff]At the start of turn[/color], gain {NascentEmotionPower:diff()} stack(s) of [rainbow][b]【Emotion】[/b][/rainbow]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMOTION_SHIELD.title: Emotion Guard Shield
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMOTION_SHIELD.descrip: Gain {Block:diff()} [b]Block[/b]. Before the [color=33ccff]start of next turn[/color], whenever you are [b]attacked[/b], gain 1 stack of [rainbow][b]【Emotion】[/b][/rainbow]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_GLOBAL_RAGE.title: Global Rage
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_GLOBAL_RAGE.descriptio: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies. Gain 1 stack of [rainbow][b]【Emotion】[/b][/rainbow] for each enemy hit
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMOTION_DIVERGE.title: Divergent Emotions
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMOTION_DIVERGE.descri:
If [rainbow][b]【Emotion】[/b][/rainbow] < 6 stacks: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to an enemy. If [rainbow][b]【Emotion】[/b][/rainbow] ≥ 6 stacks: Gain {Block:diff()} [b]Block[/b]{IfUpgraded:show:
Additionally gain [rainbow][b]【Emotion】[/b][/rainbow] stacks equal to the number of surviving allies|}
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_HANNA_ASSIST.title: Hanna's Assistance
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_HANNA_ASSIST.descripti:
[green][b]Float[/b][/green]
Draw 1 card, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to an enemy, gain 1 stack of [rainbow][b]【Emotion】[/b][/rainbow]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_MIND_COST_DRAW.title: Mind Cost Draw
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_MIND_COST_DRAW.descrip: [color=33ccff]At the start of turn[/color], choose 1 card in hand to [b]Exhaust[/b], draw {Cards:diff()} cards
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_COSMIC_APATHY.title: Cosmic Apathy
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_COSMIC_APATHY.descript: [b]Exhaust[/b] all but 1 stack of [rainbow][b]【Emotion】[/b][/rainbow]. For each stack [b]Exhausted[/b], randomly [b]attack[/b] 1 target on the field for 1 damage. If hitting an enemy, apply [color=#33ccff]【Apathy Received】[/color] to them. If hitting an ally, gain 10 stacks of [rainbow][b]【Emotion】[/b][/rainbow]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_I_HAVE_A_FRIEND.title: I Have a Friend
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_I_HAVE_A_FRIEND.descri: Choose 1 card from [b]【Others' Emotions】[/b] to give to an ally. If no ally present: Gain the [color=#33ccff]【I Am My Own Friend】[/color] ability
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_STARE_DOWN_FOOL.title: Staring Contest with a Fool
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_STARE_DOWN_FOOL.descri: Choose 1 enemy. If their intent is [b]Attack[/b]: Apply {WeakPower:diff()} stack(s) of Weak. If not [b]Attack[/b]: Apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} stack(s) of Vulnerable, then draw 1 card
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ONE_HAND_KNOCKOUT.titl: I Can Knock You Out With One Hand
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_ONE_HAND_KNOCKOUT.desc:
End an ally's turn, grant them {BufferPower:diff()} stack(s) of Buffer, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(2)}. If no ally, choose yourself.
[color=#33ccff]Remove[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SUPER_STRENGTH.title: Monstrous Strength
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SUPER_STRENGTH.descrip:
[b]Magic[/b]
[color=#33ccff][sine]「Eh~? I don't have any special powers, you know? Though I do have one special skill」[/sine][/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SHOCKWAVE_FIST.title: Shockwave Fist
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SHOCKWAVE_FIST.descrip: Gain 5 stacks of 【Shockwave】. Lose 1 HP. Randomly [b]attack[/b] 1 enemy for 1 damage
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_WITCH_TRIAL_EMOTION.de: Gain 1 stack of [rainbow][b]【Emotion】[/b][/rainbow], gain 20 [b]【Witchification】[/b], draw 1 card, then randomly [color=#33ccff]Exhaust[/color] 1 card in hand. If [b]【Witchification】[/b] = 100, clear [b]【Witchification】[/b] and [color=#33ccff]remove[/color] this card for this combat
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_WITCHIFICATION_EMOTION:
[color=#cccccc]【Tsukishiro Yuki】[/color]
Deal triple damage. For every 20 damage you deal, lose 1 HP. HP lost this way cannot reduce you to 0 [color=#cccccc](Dies at the end of turn)[/color]
[color=#33ccff][jitter]「As I thought, from birth I was a monster unable to understand people's hearts, ugly in both mind and body-- a 【Witch】」[/jitter][/color]
[b]Exhaust[/b] half of [b]【Others' Emotions】[/b]
Gain 3 stacks of [b]【Witch Ceremony】[/b], 1 stack of [color=#33ccff]Intangible[/color], 1 stack of [color=33ccff]【Remembrance】[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_THE_FOOL.title: The Fool
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_THE_FOOL.description:
[color=#33ccff][jitter]「I, too, hate myself, hate the me who had to make that choice」[/jitter][/color]
Gain 100 stacks of [b]【Witchification】[/b], 1 stack of [b]【Witch Ceremony】[/b]
Immediately trigger [color=33ccff]Case Reversal[/color], gain [color=#33ccff]【Tachibana Sherry's Magic】[/color] equal to your draw pile size, gain 2 random [rainbow][b]【Emotion】[/b][/rainbow] cards, recover Energy (up to current max) and draw cards based on your [color=#33ccff]draw pile[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_WITCHS_FIST.title: Witchification
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_WITCHS_FIST.descriptio: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. You may remove 1 Monstrous Strength card from your deck (also removing the corresponding in-combat card), or remove the Monstrous Strength ability, to gain 1 Retaining [gold]The Fool[/gold].
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_WITCHS_FIST.selectionS: Choose 1 Monstrous Strength card to remove (optional)
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_CASE_FILE_RETRIEVAL.de: For each card in 【Others' Emotions】, gain {Block:diff()} Block. Give 1 random Attack card in hand Retain
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_RETAIN_CHARGE.title: Retain Charge
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_RETAIN_STRIKE.title: Retain Strike
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_RETAIN_GUIDE.title: Retain Guide
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_RETAIN_GRANT.title: Retain Grant
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_RETAIN_GRANT.descripti: Choose 1 card in hand to gain the [color=33ccff]Witchification[/color] component
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_RETAIN_AMPLIFY.title: Retain Amplify
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_RETAIN_AMPLIFY.descrip: Increase the counter on {CardCount:diff()} random [color=33ccff]Witchification[/color] card(s) by {IfUpgraded:show:2|1}
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_RETAIN_RECOVER.title: Retain Recover
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_RETAIN_RECOVER.descrip: Choose 1 [color=33ccff]Witchification[/color] card from the discard pile, return it to your hand, and increase its counter by {IfUpgraded:show:2|1}
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_RETAIN_SWEEP.title: Retain Sweep
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_RETAIN_ECHO.title: Retain Echo
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_RETAIN_ECHO.descriptio: When [color=33ccff]Witchification[/color] increases, deal damage equal to the increase, affected by abilities, to a random target
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_RETAIN_TRANSFER.title: Retain Transfer
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_RETAIN_TRANSFER.descri: Choose 1 [color=33ccff]Witchification[/color] card to transfer its counter to another card
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_RETAIN_TRANSFER.select: Choose the card to transfer counters from
Choose the card to receive counters
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_RETAIN_BURST.title: Retain Burst
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_RETAIN_BURST.descripti: All [color=33ccff]Witchification[/color] cards in hand: Reset counter to zero. Gain 1 Energy for each counter reset
Clear your Strength loss. Choose an ally to give half of your current [b]【Suspect】[/b] stacks and equal [b]Strength[/b]. If 3 stacks are given this way, both you and the ally gain 1 stack of Hanna's Magic
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SUSPECT_TRANSFER.title: Suspect Transfer
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SUSPECT_TRANSFER.descr: Make all allies lose 1 stack of [b]【Suspect】[/b], transfer an equal amount of [b]【Suspect】[/b] to any enemy
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SUSPECT_STRENGTH.title: Strength of Suspect
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SUSPECT_STRENGTH.descr: A random ally gains 1 [b]Strength[/b] per stack of [b]【Suspect】[/b] among all allies
ManosabaLin.RetainCounterComponent.hover: Gains Retain. At the start of each turn, counter +1. Card values scale with the counter.
ManosabaLin.RemoveOnPlayComponent.hovert: Permanently remove this card from combat when played
MANOSABA_LIN_MODEL_CAPABILITY_REMOVE_ON_: Permanently remove this card from combat when played
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SHERRYMONVQIUFAN.title: Witch Prisoner
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SHERRYMONVQIUFAN.descr: Gain 6 Temporary Strength, 6 Temporary Dexterity, deal 7 damage
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_BANYANFA.title: Roleplaying Method
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_BANYANFA.description: If more than half of the cards in your draw pile are 【Witchification】, gain 1 Helplessness. Otherwise, gain 1 Curiosity
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMAXIELI.title: Ema's Assistance
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMAXIELI.description: At the start of turn, apply 10 stacks of [color=#ff99cc]【Witch Factor】[/color] to all enemies
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_DESTROY_EVERYTHING.des:
Deal 13 [color=#33ccff]damage[/color]. Immediately trigger [color=#33ccff]【Case Reversal】[/color]. Randomly remove 1 card each from your [color=#33ccff]draw, discard, and hand[/color] (Recover 1 HP, draw 1 card, and gain 1 Energy per card removed).
Deal damage equal to five times [b]【Suspect】[/b] to all enemies. [b]Exhaust[/b] up to 4 cards from [b]【Others' Emotions】[/b], deal 8 damage to a random enemy for each (if [rainbow][b]【Complex Emotion】[/b][/rainbow], hit all enemies).
Reset all [color=#33ccff]【Witchification】[/color] counters to zero. For each counter reset, generate 1 card with cost reduced by 1. If ≥13 counters were reset, trigger [color=#33ccff]【Case Reversal】[/color] again, randomly gain [green]Helplessness[/green] or [color=#33ccff]Curiosity[/color], and refill Energy to maximum
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_DUAL_FIST.title: Left Hand Strong, Right Hand Stronger
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_DUAL_FIST.description: At the start of turn, randomly gain 【Left Fist】 or 【Right Fist】
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMPTY_HOUSE.title: Empty House
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_EMPTY_HOUSE.descriptio:
While Retained, mark 1 card in the Exhaust pile.
When played, deal 6 damage. Deal an additional hit per marked card, and add the marked cards to your hand. If 【Case Reversal】 triggered this turn, these cards cost 0 this turn
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_FINAL_FAREWELL.title: Final Farewell
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_FINAL_FAREWELL.descrip:
Clear all [b]【Witchification】[/b]
[thinky_dots][b][color=#33ccff]「After the storm passes, there will be a [/color][/b][/thinky_dots][b][thinky_dots][green]cleaner, better, more solid land under the sun」[/green][/thinky_dots][/b]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_LAST_CASE.title: The Final Problem
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_LAST_CASE.description: Choose 1 Emotion card to Retain. [b]Exhaust[/b] all other Emotion cards from [b]【Others' Emotions】[/b]. Deal 13 damage, plus an additional 4 damage per card [b]Exhausted[/b]. If Case Reversal triggered, each deals {IfUpgraded:show:10|8} instead and gain a random basic Emotion. If ≥8 cards were [b]Exhausted[/b], immediately trigger 【Case Reversal】, gain Curiosity or Helplessness, and gain {IfUpgraded:show:2|1} stack(s) of 【Complex Emotion】
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SACRIFICE_TANK.title: Star-Crossed Lovers
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SACRIFICE_TANK.descrip:
Take double damage from enemies. Damage dealt to allies is halved.
For every 20 attack damage accumulated, gain 1 stack of Next Turn Energy, and other allies each gain 1 stack of Next Turn Draw and 10 stacks of Witchification
ManosabaLin.Sherryyuanzui.hovertip.title: Destruction Detective
ManosabaLin.Sherryyuanzui.hovertip.descr: [color=#33ccff][jitter]She destroyed everything. Cases, people, and even her own heart.[/jitter][/color]

MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SHERRYBADENDING.title: [Bad Ending]
MANOSABA_LIN_CARD_SHERRYBADENDING.descri:
[color=#33ccff][jitter]"At the end of the flower sea, the souls of the living shall warm thy fingertips. After the embrace, an eternal farewell."[/jitter][/color]
[b]When discarded, returns to hand. When [b]Exhausted[/b], returns to hand.[/b]
At the start of your turn, gain 3 [b][Suspect][/b]. Cannot gain [color=#33ccff][Orange Sherry's Magic][/color] when [color=#33ccff][Retrial][/color] triggers, and remove half of all cards.
At the end of your turn, reduce [color=#33ccff][Witchification][/color] count on cards in hand by 1 and remove 2 [rainbow][b][Emotion][/b][/rainbow] cards.

ManosabaLin.SherryDeath.hovertip.title: Witch Execution
ManosabaLin.SherryDeath.hovertip.descrip:
[b]This card returns to your hand at the start of each [color=#33ccff]turn[/color].[/b]
On play, inflict [color=#cccccc]Death[/color] and give half of all allies' cards [color=#33ccff][Orange Sherry's Magic][/color].
If the number of [b][Others' Emotions][/b] cards is greater than 2, add 1 random [rainbow][b][Basic Emotion][/b][/rainbow] to an ally's draw pile. Greater than 4, add a [rainbow][b][Complex Emotion][/b][/rainbow]. Greater than 20, add [color=#33ccff][b]"Friend[/b][/color][green][b]ship"[/b][/green].
[b]Exhaust[/b] 50 stacks of [b][Witchification][/b] and 3 stacks of [b][Suspect][/b] from all allies.
